description: A sprite sheet of SIXTEEN separate small crop plants arranged in a grid of 4 columns and 4 rows, each centered in its own cell, growth stages from left to right (1 sprout, 2 young, 3 growing, 4 ripe ready to harvest). Row 1 rice paddy: tiny rice sprout in a little puddle, young green rice tuft, tall green rice, golden rice with drooping grain heads. Row 2 corn: tiny sprout, small corn plant, tall corn stalk, tall corn stalk with two yellow corn cobs. Row 3 tomato: tiny sprout, small tomato plant, tomato plant on a stick with yellow flowers, tomato plant with bright red tomatoes. Row 4 watermelon: tiny sprout, small vine, vine with a small striped melon, big ripe striped green watermelon among vines. Each plant upright on a tiny dark soil mound, front view, slight top-down, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, natural colors, every plant fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background, no field, no shadow, no text, no numbers
style_usage: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one object centered in each cell. Do not copy these objects, their colors or their layout.
